UI_BooksAtHome_ClearConfirm: Clear every mark on this server?
UI_COOP_MapShareMP_tt:
Share what you draw.
Every new symbol and note goes to all players on the server as soon as you place it.
Turn it off to draw only for yourself.
UI_COOP_Output_Hands_tt:
Items you craft or remove go into your inventory.
This is the vanilla behaviour.
UI_COOP_Output_Bag_tt:
Items go into the worn bag with the most room left.
If no bag will take it, it stays in your inventory.
UI_COOP_Output_Nearby_tt:
Items go into the container you have open, or the closest one within two tiles.
If it is full or out of reach, they stay in your inventory.
UI_COOP_Output_Ground_tt:
Items drop at your feet.
Handy for planks, logs and car parts.
